edits:
INV-9–INV-14 add the coordinated invention foundation. They extend the existing service and the unfinished responsibilities below; they do not replace INV-1–INV-8, reset their acceptance, or create a second task registry. Checked finite delivery remains distinct from the open parent implementation and qualification requirements. EWF, AG, EPR, CR, NC, PF, SL and production-data retain their subsystem ownership.
- [ ] **2.1 Preserve structured intent and clicked-target scope.** Carry explicit invention intent, optional clicked entity/location and observed revision through the existing entrypoints; the server verifies references and binds authority. The finite recipe shortcut retains its `invent`/`discuss` contract, while the native owner session pins its own purpose and grants. Do not infer authorization solely from an `Invent this:` string or silently turn quoted conversation into authoring. Complete clicked-target continuity; a new Workshop mode is not remaining scope under the accepted unified-conversation decision.
  - [x] Route the finite Invent entry points with explicit intent and server-bound actor, authority, world and timeline. INV-21 and WW18–WW23 subsequently deliver purpose-bound native owner conversations; neither profile grants the other its authority.
- [ ] **2.2 Complete bounded invention entrypoint qualification.** Reuse INV-1 under each conversation's server-bound scope. The finite recipe inference/supplied-candidate paths and the native MCP owner-authoring path are delivered for their distinct purposes; a typed final-response envelope is not a replacement or fallback for the latter. After similarity search and any explicit choice, Invent can enter recipe preparation without paying for a preliminary turn to repeat the request. Preserve an already retained valid candidate or a complete actor/player-supplied method without commissioning a second generation, retaining conceptual fidelity and requiring acceptance of substantive substitutions. Broader investigation and the full 2.6 player journey remain open.
  - [x] Deliver supported-family inference and complete supplied candidates, followed by purpose-selected native owner recipe preparation under WW18–WW23. Reuse their scoped evidence; do not restart those implementations or infer deployment/full-loop qualification from local success.
  - [x] Expose the actor-scoped catalogue/material/recipe/used-system inspection and native dry-run profile. INV-15/16/21 and WW12–WW23 subsequently deliver separate authorized world-level reads, bounded tracing and seven-kind reviewed authoring through the shared owners. Extend only missing source/kind coverage and executable impact analysis; the current reader and finite adapters are not pending implementations.
  - [x] Deliver the four-turn/eight-tool ordinary-inference recipe investigation and zero-call supplied route. The separate native owner harness later gains selected profiles, source-backed context and local real authoring evidence under WW18–WW23. Preserve those actual consumers rather than treating the earlier inference loop as a native-harness substitute; larger family/dependency investigations and deployed quality remain open.
- [ ] **4.12 Complete conversation/actor integration qualification.** The unified owner conversation already reaches the shared dispatcher with explicit purpose, audience and exact review/Apply under INV-21.4; do not add a second more capable creator mode. Complete its remaining deployed/browser and broader usability criteria through WW07/WW11 and PW05/PW11. Actor tool investigation belongs to AG08/CH01 and must not inherit human Apply requirements or private creator evidence. Preserve the cheap finite Invent and supplied-NPC paths; their presence does not qualify the broader seamless experience.
- [ ] **11.3 Extend the finite native preparation into an impact-aware validation planner.** WW18–WW23 already retain exact native-admission, required-reference and presentation checks with explicit blocked/pending outcomes. Reuse that owner and add the missing reverse consumers, shared resources, query membership, event/cognition consequences, freezes and active-state dependencies. Cheap eligibility/schema/reference checks precede broader analysis and paid work. Never truncate a mandatory closure to top-K semantic matches and call it complete; return bounded pending or explicitly narrower review. The existing three-check plan does not establish general impact coverage.
- [ ] **11.8 Extend retained evidence and qualify safe reuse.** Current native preparation already persists candidate identity, analysis version, dependency content and timeline; exact approval/Apply recheck freshness. Extend that existing record for the missing semantic/isolated scenarios, relevant host/family/test versions, constitutional and query-membership dependencies, assumptions and seeds rather than adding a parallel evidence store. Keep native, semantic, isolated and live results distinct. Current authority/action prerequisites remain fresh; new consumers invalidate relevant negative conclusions, and cross-world reuse rechecks destination policy and rights.
- [ ] **16.2 Register operations once.** Share validators, metadata, handlers, output projections and native mutation services between UI, current functional structured-inference callers and MCP adapters. Add a stable operation catalogue for actual implemented kinds; unsupported tools/kinds are not advertised as executable. Retain zero-model native reads, supplied candidates and Apply.
- [ ] **18.4 Extend attributable session accounting to image work.** Reuse the existing session/Run allocation and default $5 cap, including lower configured limits, with attributable model, semantic, embedding, art and validation charges in the same ledger and no fixed art split. Shared Worker capacity remains separately owner-managed and billed; the accepted [runtime funding contract](../world-agent-runtime.md#8-shared-5-allowance-and-external-runs) supersedes the earlier all-inclusive compute promise. Before enabling image or paid validation tools, reserve their enforceable maximum alongside the native Run allocation and avoid double-counting included charges. If a Run holds needed funds, settle/reallocate through a supported operation or end/reconcile it first; never release uncertain exposure to make room.
- [ ] **18.7 Extend truthful usage and owner cost reporting.** The delivered player-facing conversation shows abstract usage remaining, while owner details expose settled, held and uncertain costs. Preserve that separation when adding art/purpose breakdown and later job states; do not put dollars, provider/compute terms or invention-count estimates in the creation flow. An unavailable reading is not zero or exhaustion. Publication of an already funded valid result needs no new generation allowance. A fresh session/top-up requires an explicit payer-authorized operation; ordinary mechanic/crafting fiction cannot increase funds.
files.summary: retire superseded authoring modes and align validation, Worker funding and usage tasks
